questions.q: What is IO Resource's single best-selling Aures product by revenue?
questions.e: The Yuno II 15.6" Tiger Lake i3 is ~80% of all IOR Aures revenue (~694 units). Lead with it.

questions.q: A customer has an ageing TRX-3000 estate. What is IOR's recommended path?
o: Migrate to Yuno II as the direct successor
questions.e: TRX-3000 is legacy with thinning parts availability. Yuno II is the same family with current CPUs, NVMe and Windows 11 IoT — the easy upgrade.

questions.q: What makes the ODP 333 receipt printer suited to kitchens and bars?
o: It has a front paper exit and splash-proof cubic design
It is the cheapest printer available
questions.e: The ODP 333's front receipt exit and cubic body resist dust, crumbs and splashes; it also has a triple interface and Energy Star certification.
